stories.headline: Trump envoy Kushner arrives in Israel after rare Hamas talks on Gaza peace plan
stories.description: Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner is expected to meet Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu on Monday.

stories.headline: Burnham exchanged messages with person posing as Trump's chief of staff
stories.description: Downing Street has declined to comment on the security breach, first reported by Politico.

stories.headline: Will India’s ‘Cockroach’ movement force Modi’s BJP to rethink its politics?
stories.description: Modi’s BJP once controlled media narratives in India, but this might be changing with the ‘Cockroach’ movement.

stories.headline: At least six people killed in Ukrainian missile attack on Russia’s Belgorod
stories.description: Overnight Russian missile and drone attacks across Ukraine kill two people and injure 19.

stories.headline: US military expands anti-cartel operations in Latin America from sea to land
stories.description: The US is partnering with regional allies to expand its anti-cartel military campaign onto land.
